caveats: One randomized timing action followed by frozen policy; not a fixed-period baseline
Four independent connections per scene/period; real outcomes noisy, not precise counterfactual labels
Dense continuation targets overlap; train/heldout are separate connections and phases
No actor optimization; improved value fit is not improved congestion performance
External shutdown interrupted three trials; original41 completed retained; three fresh retry IDs; repeat1 contains only complete post-reboot blocks
These development traces cannot later be counted as unseen paper tests
decision: No automatic joint update; require prospective timing evidence and all real-trace value gates
